diagnostics.message: `kubectl_manifest.karpenter_provisioner` references the AWSNodeTemplate `default` via `spec.providerRef.name = "default"`, but has no dependency on `kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template`. If the Provisioner is applied before the NodeTemplate exists, Karpenter cannot resolve the providerRef and node provisioning fails until the template appears; the ordering is only enforced operationally, not by any attribute reference or depends_on.
